about.text: Telemea is the name of a Romanian cheese traditionally made of sheep's milk. Nowadays the term encompasses cheese made out of cow's milk, and in some cases of goat's, or buffalo's milk.

how.text: Telemea curd is pressed, cut into squares and matured in brine, which makes it crisper, saltier and more flavoured with age; the PDO Telemea de Ibănești is distinguished by brine taken from a local salt-water spring.
